release_name: A shared Mass link opened the wrong Mass
notes: Found by testing deep links for the first time. Sharing a Mass produces a link ending in #row=<id>. Opened cold that works. But tapping one while the app is ALREADY open only changes the fragment - the page does not reload - and the app bound its restore handler to popstate alone. popstate fires for back and forward; navigating to a different fragment of the same page fires hashchange instead. So nothing ran: whichever Mass was already on screen stayed there, and the shared one never opened. Someone sent a link to a 07:00 Tuesday Mass could sit looking at a 06:30 Sunday one at a different church and have no idea the link had done nothing. The handler is now bound to both events and also reconciles the open sheet with the hash, so a link carrying no Mass closes a stale one instead of leaving it up. Verified all four cases: cold shared link opens the right Mass; a different shared link while open switches to it; a non-Mass link closes the sheet; and returning to a Mass link opens it again. Also verified in this pass, with no defects found: saved churches persist to localStorage, survive a reload and render in My Churches; and no site_uid has changed in any release this session, so no saved church was silently lost - including through the Saint-Coeur-de-Marie town correction, because site_uid is a stored field rather than derived from the town. No data change: 426 rows.
